name: Starcare Hospital
meta: Starcare Hospital: eight sites across Oman, the UAE and India, with specialist departments, check-up packages and an in-house pharmacy.

hero.title: Specialist care at eight sites
hero.lede: From Seeb and Barka to Muscat, Bousher, Saha, Duqm and Sharjah, with check-up packages, specialist departments and an in-house pharmacy.

about.title: Eight sites, one hospital group
body: Starcare operates six sites in Oman, one in Sharjah in the UAE, and one listed in Calicut, India. Each site lists its own address and phone number.

points.title: Workforce
points.text: Over 500 doctors, nurses, paramedics and support staff, according to the group's site.

points.title: In-house pharmacy
points.text: The pharmacy stocks a range of lifesaving medicines.

points.title: Check-ups & packages
points.text: Health check packages are offered across the group.

services.title: Specialist departments
services.intro: Departments named on the group's homepage. Which site offers which department is not listed.

contact.title: Book an appointment
contact.intro: Pick a site and send a request. For urgent care, call the site directly.
contact.address: Starcare Hospital, PO Box 198, PC 101, As Seeb, Sultanate of Oman
contact.note: No emergency number is published on the site. The booking form is a concept preview.

confirm: Seeb, Saha, Duqm and Calicut all list the same address and phone numbers. Mabela shares Seeb's PO box. Verify each branch's own address and phone.
The Calicut entry gives an Oman address. Verify the Indian address.
The Sharjah entry lists both a UAE and an Oman phone number. The concept uses the UAE number.
No emergency number, bed count or founding year is published.
The staff figure ('over 500') is the group's own wording.
Photography is illustrative Creative Commons imagery (see footer credits): city views on the site list and stock clinical images, not Starcare's own facilities.
